title: data.pdf — section 267
text:
6 In section 13 (1) for “the bill of indictment is preferred” substitute “ the indictment
is presented ”.

7 After section 14 there shall be inserted—
[F160“Public interest: review for offences tried under section 5 of the Justice
and Security (Northern Ireland) Act 2007]

(1) This section applies where this Part applies by virtue of section 1(2) and
[F161section 5 of the Justice and Security (Northern Ireland) Act 2007 (trials
on indictment without a jury) applies in relation to the trial of the accused
for the offence charged] .

(2) At any time—
(a) after a court makes an order under section [F1623(6), 7A(8) or 8(5)],
and
(b) before the accused is acquitted or convicted or the prosecutor
decides not to proceed with the case concerned,
the accused may apply to the court for a review of the question whether it is
still not in the public interest to disclose material affected by its order.
